description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class for managing notes, exposing CRUD endpoints with pagination and filtering support.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller class providing endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing notes with pagination and filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note; returns ResponseEntity with created NoteResponse and Location header.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a note by ID; returns ResponseEntity with NoteResponse.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to replace an existing note; returns ResponseEntity with updated NoteResponse.

methods.name: partialUpdate
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests for partial updates to a note; returns ResponseEntity with updated NoteResponse.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a note by ID; returns ResponseEntity with no content.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list notes with pagination and optional filters q and tag; returns a Page of NoteResponse.

methods.name: buildPageable
methods.description: Helper method to create Pageable object based on page, size, and sort parameters.
